vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

contact_vis = False

tire_step_size = step_size

vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type, vis_type)

vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type, vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# 1. Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components
chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())  # Ensure data path is set

# Create the physical system (ChSystem)
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# 2. Add the required physical systems and objects as specified

# Create the rigid terrain
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(system)
# Create a patch (flat terrain)
patch = terrain.AddPatch(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
                         200, 200,  # size in x and y
                         "concrete.jpg",  # texture
                         1000,  # friction coefficient
                         0.01)  # restitution coefficient
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
patch.SetTextureScale(20, 20)
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the Kraz vehicle
vehicle = veh.Kraz(system, chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5), chrono.QUNIT))
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.Initialize()

# Set initial vehicle position and orientation
init_loc = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5)
init_rot = chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(0, chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1))
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(init_loc, init_rot))

# Initialize the vehicle system (call after setting initial position)
vehicle.Initialize()

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(vehicle.GetVehicle(), chronoirr.ChIrrApp(vehicle.GetVehicle().GetSystem(), "Kraz Vehicle Simulation", chronoirr.dimension2du(1280, 720)))
driver.SetInputDelay(0.1)  # small input delay

# 3. Set necessary default parameters such as positions, forces, and interactions

# Create the Irrlicht application for visualization
app = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(system, "Kraz Vehicle Simulation", chronoirr.dimension2du(1280, 720))

# Add typical elements
app.AddTypicalSky()
app.AddTypicalLights()
app.AddTypicalCamera(chronoirr.vector3df(0, -10, 1.5))

# Bind all assets and update all assets
app.AssetBindAll()
app.AssetUpdateAll()

# Simulation parameters
timestep = 0.01

# 4. Simulation loop
app.SetTimestep(timestep)
app.SetTryRealtime(True)

while app.GetDevice().run():
    app.BeginScene()
    app.DrawAll()

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Synchronize modules
    time = system.GetChTime()
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    app.Synchronize("", driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation by timestep
    driver.Advance(timestep)
    terrain.Advance(timestep)
    vehicle.Advance(timestep)
    app.Advance(timestep)

    system.DoStepDynamics(timestep)

    app.EndScene()
```

```python
terrainLength = 100.0  # size in X direction
terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Poon chassis tracked by the camera
trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(3, 0, 2.1)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the kraz vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
vehicle = veh.Kraz()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type, vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type, vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type, vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type, vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat,
                        chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, terrainHeight), chrono.QUNIT),
                        terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('Kraz Demo')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 25.0, 10.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())  # Corrected from GetTractor() to GetVehicle()

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

# Double lane change maneuver parameters
# Define time intervals for the maneuver (seconds)
# For example:
# 0-2s: straight
# 2-4s: steer left
# 4-6s: steer right
# 6-8s: steer left
# 8-10s: straighten steering
# Throttle full during maneuver, no braking

def lane_change_steering(time):
    # Steering values for double lane change maneuver
    # Max steering angle normalized [-1,1]
    max_steering = 0.6
    if 2.0 <= time < 4.0:
        return max_steering  # steer left
    elif 4.0 <= time < 6.0:
        return -max_steering  # steer right
    elif 6.0 <= time < 8.0:
        return max_steering  # steer left
    elif 8.0 <= time < 10.0:
        return 0.0  # straighten
    else:
        return 0.0  # straight

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs from interactive driver
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Override steering, throttle, and braking inputs for double lane change maneuver
    # Steering: controlled by lane_change_steering function
    # Throttle: full throttle (1.0)
    # Braking: no braking (0.0)
    steering_input = lane_change_steering(time)
    throttle_input = 1.0
    braking_input = 0.0

    # Create a new inputs object with overridden values
    # The driver inputs object is of type ChDriver::Inputs, which has fields:
    # .m_steering, .m_throttle, .m_braking
    driver_inputs.m_steering = steering_input
    driver_inputs.m_throttle = throttle_input
    driver_inputs.m_braking = braking_input

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```
